scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
Welcome.
Honorable Knight,
would you like to rent
a Peco Peco? The rental
fee is {0} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥飼養員]
歡迎光臨，尊敬的騎士。
要租一隻大嘴鳥嗎？租金是{0} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
I'm sorry, but these
Peco Pecos are only
available for Knights
and Lord Knights.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥飼養員]
很抱歉，大嘴鳥僅供騎士和騎士領主租用。

scripts.text: Rent Peco Peco
scripts.translation: 租大嘴鳥

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
You do not
have enough zeny.
Are you...
bankrupt?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥飼養員]
您的Zeny不足。
您該不會...破產了吧？

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
I'm sorry, but you're
not eligible for this
service. Please go learn
the Peco Peco Ride skill first.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥飼養員]
很抱歉，您不符合
使用本服務的條件。
請先學習騎乘術。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
You're already
mounted on a
Peco Peco.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥飼養員]
您已經騎著大嘴鳥了。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
Please remove your cash mount.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥飼養員]
請先解除商城坐騎。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
I see.
Well then,
have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥飼養員]
明白了，祝您今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
Welcome, Crusader.
We have a special
Peco Peco prepared
for you. To rent one
will cost {0} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥飼養員]
歡迎光臨，十字軍。
我們為您準備了特別的大嘴鳥，租金是{0} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
Welcome, Paladin.
We have a special
Peco Peco prepared
for you. To rent one
will cost {0} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥飼養員]
歡迎光臨，聖殿十字軍。
我們為您準備了特別的大嘴鳥，租金是{0} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
What can I do for you?
Please be aware that
this Peco Peco rental
service is strictly for
Crusaders and Paladins.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥飼養員]
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？
請注意，這項大嘴鳥租賃服務僅供十字軍和聖殿十字軍使用。

scripts.text: Rent a PecoPeco
scripts.translation: 租大嘴鳥

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
You do not
have enough zeny.
If you would like
a Peco Peco please
bring {0} zeny...
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥飼養員]
您的Zeny不夠，想租大嘴鳥，請準備{0} Zeny...

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
You must first learn
to ride a PecoPeco before
I can rent one to you.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥飼養員]
在您學會騎乘大嘴鳥之前，
我無法將大嘴鳥租給您。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
You are already
mounted on a Peco Peco.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥飼養員]
您已經騎著大嘴鳥了。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
Please remove your cash mount.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥飼養員]
請先解除商城坐騎。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
See you around.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥飼養員]
回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
Um...
You can't rent a Falcon
until you dismiss your warg first!
scripts.translation:
[獵鷹飼養員]
嗯...得先解除戰狼，才能租獵鷹！

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
Do you need a Falcon?
You can rent your own
trusty bird of prey for a
fee of just {0} zeny~
scripts.translation:
[獵鷹飼養員]
需要獵鷹嗎？
只要{0} Zeny，就能租到一隻可靠的猛禽夥伴~

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
Young fool!
Falcons can only
be used by Hunters
and Snipers, capish?
...Heh heh, jealous?
scripts.translation:
[獵鷹飼養員]
傻小子！只有獵人和神射手才能使用獵鷹，懂嗎？
...Heh heh，羨慕吧？

scripts.text: Rent Falcon
scripts.translation: 租獵鷹

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
Um...
You can't rent a Falcon
until you dismiss your warg first!
scripts.translation:
[獵鷹飼養員]
嗯...得先解除戰狼，才能租獵鷹！

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
What is this?
You don't have
enough zeny?!
You better start
hunting money
instead of monsters~
scripts.translation:
[獵鷹飼養員]
什麼？Zeny不夠？！
先別忙著打魔物，去賺點錢吧~

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
Gosh~
Go learn how to
manage a Falcon
first! I can't rent one
to you if you can't
handle it, you know.
scripts.translation:
[獵鷹飼養員]
哎呀~先學會駕馭獵鷹吧！
您不會使用，我可不能租給您。

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
Um...
You already have
a Falcon. It's right
there, can't you see it?
scripts.translation:
[獵鷹飼養員]
嗯...您已經有獵鷹了，就在那兒，沒看見嗎？

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
W-wait, where're
you goin'? These
Falcons are top notch,
I guarantee it! C'mon, yo~
scripts.translation:
[獵鷹飼養員]
等...等等，您要去哪兒？
這些獵鷹都是頂尖的，我保證！來嘛~
